We need to generate a diverse list of oxide compositions (max 40). Then batch retrieve polymorphs with max_energy_above_hull 0.3, max_per_composition 3. Use batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool. Then consolidate into single dataset. Use consolidate_polymorph_datasets? That expects dict mapping composition to file paths. batch_retrieve_polymorphs saves each composition JSON in a directory. Then we can list files and map composition names to file paths. Then consolidate.

First need list of oxide compositions. Could generate common oxides: e.g., Al2O3, SiO2, TiO2, Fe2O3, FeO, ZnO, MgO, CaO, SrO, BaO, CuO, Cu2O, NiO, CoO, MnO, Mn2O3, Cr2O3, SnO2, PbO, PbO2, V2O5, MoO3, WO3, ZrO2, HfO2, Y2O3, La2O3, CeO2, Nd2O3, Sm2O3, Gd2O3, Ti3O5, Fe3O4, SiO, GeO2, In2O3, Ga2O3, Bi2O3, Sb2O5.
